hypothesis.claim: The production F arm's exact first-half midpoint gradient has one stable non-head parameter-group concentration across every chronological third, localizing one deep group for a separately frozen causal ablation.
hypothesis.falsification: Retire gradient-energy localization if exact repeated F archives and named gradients are valid but no single non-head group dominates every third with the frozen share and output-head bounds.

changedMechanism: Instrument only the production F arm's already-authorized first-half midpoint backward pass to emit parameter-name, shape, hash, finiteness, and squared-gradient-energy witnesses; do not alter its update or probabilities.
invariants: The emitted archive must remain byte-identical to the retained production F archive.
Two independent instrumented encodes must emit byte-identical archives and named gradient rows.
Every midpoint block must expose the same complete named parameter set and finite gradient energies.
Gradient magnitude is localization evidence only and is not probability contribution, codec gain, or objective credit.
No group ablation, open correction, or additive forecast is authorized by this experiment itself.

controls.definition: Two clean builds of the same instrumented production F encode path with named gradient capture enabled only during each first-half midpoint backward pass.
The hash-bound uninstrumented production F archive already independently decoded to the exact raw population.
The previously failed output-head-only mechanism remains excluded; a head-dominated gradient cannot authorize a deep-group successor.

population.selection: The exact frozen opening 65,536-symbol population used by the retained P/K/O/OK/F/S attribution gate.
population.coordinate: Thirty-two chronological 64-state blocks over the production 16,392-symbol alphabet.

availableInformation: Named gradients produced by the first 32 decoded symbols of each production F block.
Parameter names, tensor shapes, deterministic gradient hashes, and squared gradient energy.
The retained exact F archive and terminal attribution receipts.
forbiddenInformation: Second-half truth symbols before they are decoded.
Any fitted correction, group ablation result, future gate result, or full-corpus score.
Treating the closed LibNC teacher, gradients, or traces as shippable Gamma state.

measurements.definition: Both instrumented F archives equal the retained F archive byte for byte.
Archive identity transfers the retained exact raw inverse receipt.
The two complete ordered named-gradient row sets are identical.
Every midpoint block reports the same unique parameter names.
Every named gradient and squared energy is finite.
The overall dominant non-head group is also dominant in every chronological third.
Minimum across thirds of the selected group's share of non-head squared gradient energy.
Output-head squared gradient energy divided by total squared gradient energy.
Stable dominance, minimum third share, or maximum output-head share failed.
Number of unique named parameters per complete block.
